description.value:
You gain Proficiency in two of the following skills: Animal Handling, Arcana, Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Religion, Survival.

Alternatively, you may replace a chosen skill with one of the following tools: Alchemist's Supplies, Cook's Utensils, Enchanter's Supplies, Herbalist's Kit, Poisoner's Kit, or Tinkerer's Tools.

If you are already proficient in a chosen skill or tool, you add double your Proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

Additionally, you can use Intelligence for skill checks with a chosen skill or tool if it normally uses a different ability score.

You can choose two additional skills or tools for this feature when you reach 10th level in this class.
